_comment: Fleet topology defaults for eflips-impact. Describes the rows that must exist
before a TCO calculation can run: one BatteryType per battery-electric vehicle
type, and one ChargingPointType per charging type.
'battery_type_default' supplies these values for every vehicle type. There is no
per-vehicle-type list: django-simba fleets come from user uploads with arbitrary
names, so name matching found nothing to match.
ChargingPointType has no 'type' column in the database, so 'name_short' carries
the depot/opportunity discriminator (see DEPOT_CPT_NAME_SHORT in impact.py).
